Our client is a well-established manufacturing company based in Drongen, specializing in the production of high-quality coffins. To strengthen their production team, they are looking for a motivated Machine Operator (CNC Milling Machine) to join their permanent night shift.

Jobomschrijving

Your Responsibilities

• Operate a CNC milling/routing machine.
• Monitor the production process and ensure smooth machine operation.
• Perform quality checks on finished products.
• Maintain a safe and organized work environment.
• Assist with material handling when required.

Your Profile

• Experience operating CNC machinery is an advantage.
• Forklift experience or a valid forklift certificate is considered a strong plus.
• You are willing to complete a training period of approximately 3 months in either the early or late shift before transitioning to the permanent night shift.
• You can communicate effectively in Dutch, English, or French.
• You are detail-oriented and committed to quality.
• You are reliable and comfortable working in a production environment.

Our client, a well-established company in the food production industry located in Zottegem, is looking for a motivated and experienced Technical Operator.Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?As a Technical Operator, you play a crucial role in the production process.You ensure that the production lines run efficiently and intervene quickly whenever deviations occur. Thanks to your technical insight, accuracy, and problem-solving skills, production continues smoothly.Your responsibilities: 
• Setting up, operating, and monitoring production lines. 
• Performing quality checks and making adjustments where necessary. 
• Detecting technical malfunctions and independently resolving minor defects. 
• Carrying out machine changeovers, cleaning your equipment, and ensuring machines function correctly. 
• Recording production data and strictly following established procedures. 
• Assisting with preventive maintenance and actively contributing ideas for process improvements. 
• Maintaining a safe, clean, and organized work environment at all times.Working hours are from Sunday evening to Friday morning in a fixed night shift from 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM.
 
• You have previous experience as a Technical Operator. 
• You have a strong technical interest and are eager to learn. 
• You are willing to work in a fixed night shift. 
• You have a good command of Dutch and/or English. 
• You work accurately, responsibly, and have a strong focus on quality. 
• You can independently analyze and solve technical issues. 
• You are a team player and communicate effectively with colleagues. 
• You perform well under pressure in a fast-paced production environment. 
• You have a hands-on mentality and enjoy taking initiative. 
• You have your own transportation or can easily commute to the workplace during night hours. 
• You live within a 20 km radius of Zottegem.

Our client is building one of the most advanced glass factories in the world in Lommel. This ultramodern site excels in sustainability, automation, and technological innovation. As a TECHNICIAN, you play a key role in the maintenance and operation of this state-of-the-art production environment, where safety, efficiency, and environmental awareness are at the forefront.

Jobomschrijving

Well before the startup, you will begin thorough training in day shifts to fully understand our installations, systems, and standards, enabling you to help set the standard in this unique factory from day one.

Depending on your background (electrical or mechanical), you will be deployed as a technician within one of the teams. Your tasks will include:

• Maintenance and monitoring of electrical systems, such as switchboards, electrical installations, and emergency repairs;
• Supervision of gas installations, ensuring safety and proper functioning of these systems;
• Maintenance of HVAC systems (Heating, Ventilation, Air Conditioning), ensuring adequate temperature and air quality in buildings;
• Diagnostics and repair of heating systems.

Profile:

• You have completed technical training and have relevant experience 
• You are strong in mechanical and/or electrical areas
• You are solution-oriented and enjoy working in a team
• You are skilled in reading technical plans or schematics
• You can work in a 6-shift system and are looking for a stable, long-term challenge
• You speak good English.

?? Where’s all this happening?

At a company based at Arcelor Mittal (Ghent/Zelzate) – not just any place!They’re experts in packing machines, installations, steel, and more. If it needs wrapping, these folks do it better than bubble wrap.

Jobomschrijving

Looking for a job where your muscles will finally have something to do – and steel will tremble at the sight of you? We’ve got just the thing for you!

Our client is on the hunt for a new team member – a packer with personality, humor, and the guts to face the mighty steel rolls in a three-shift battle. If you're not afraid of a challenge, love to stay active, and see “team” as more than just a word – then you’re exactly who they’re looking for!

Ready to roll?

Click, apply, and pack your future with us – strong, stable, and well-paid.

Who are we looking for?

Maybe you, if:

• You’re in shape – no need to be The Rock, but lifting steel rolls does require more than just clicking a mouse ??,
• Shifts? Three? You’re in – no whining, no problem,
• You take safety seriously (a forklift is not a race car ?),
• Small talk is your superpower – you feel like a fish in water speaking Dutch or English.

In 1932, Belgian baker Jan Boone created a caramelised biscuit made only from natural ingredients. He named it Lotus, after the flower that symbolises purity. In the 1950s, Boone began wrapping his Speculoos individually and introduced them to cafés and restaurants as “the biscuit to enjoy with your coffee”. The idea was an instant hit, because coffee and Lotus Speculoos are made for each other: each one brings out the best in the other’s flavour, and together they form the perfect duo. Over the years, the popularity of Lotus Speculoos grew enormously, far beyond Belgium’s borders. From a caffè latte to an espresso to go, coffee lovers all over the world ask for a Lotus. Internationally, the biscuit is known as Lotus Biscoff, a contraction of “biscuit with coffee”. Today, Speculoos is much more than a biscuit to go with your coffee. Creative chefs also use it as an ingredient in delicious desserts such as tiramisu and speculoos mousse.

Jobomschrijving

Are you a hands-on technician who loves keeping production lines running smoothly? Our client, a world-famous Belgian cookie producer, is looking for a Maintenance Technician to join its technical team in Lembeke (East Flanders). You will help keep its large baking and packing lines running, in a growing company with a long history.

What you will do

• Plan and execute major maintenance stops together with the technical team

• Find and solve mechanical and electrical problems

Your profile

• Strong mechanical skills (about 70%) and good electrical knowledge (about 30%)
• A technical diploma is a plus, but solid hands-on experience counts just as much
• Driven, reliable and proactive, able to work both independently and in a team
• Good English; Dutch is not required
• Valid Belgian work permit

A packed schedule, a hundred things happening at once and always something that needs sorting out. Sound familiar?
  
Some people find that stressful. You actually thrive on it!
  
As Management & Personal Assistant, you'll become a trusted right hand to management, providing both professional and personal support.
  
But here's what really makes the difference: you don't just get things started, you make sure they're properly taken care of, right down to the smallest detail. 
  
You'll be trusted to take ownership, anticipate needs and find solutions independently, without constant reminders or follow-ups.
  
The goal? To give management the peace of mind that when something is in your hands, it's taken care of.
  
No two days are quite the same. And that's exactly what makes this role so interesting!
  
Your responsibilities cover two main areas.
  
Management Support – Making things happen behind the scenes
    
• You manage inboxes, calendars and daily communications, ensuring everything is followed up efficiently.  
• You organise and prepare meetings, appointments and discussions.  
• You gather information, bring structure and create clear, practical overviews.  
• You keep track of deadlines, action points and ongoing projects.  
• You provide administrative and organisational support across various management responsibilities, including sales and HR.  
• You liaise with colleagues, suppliers and external partners.  
• You assist with the practical organisation of business trips, trade fairs, reservations and events.  
• When management is away, you keep things moving. You follow up on important matters, handle what you can independently and provide a clear overview upon their return.   
Personal & Household Management – Making life easier!
  
Beyond business support, you'll also help keep the personal lives of the management team running smoothly.
  
This isn't a housekeeping position. It's about coordinating, organising and taking care of practical matters that make everyday life easier.
    
• You coordinate external household help and manage the related planning and communication.  
• You arrange home maintenance, repairs, deliveries and appointments.  
• You handle practical errands and purchases for both the company and private needs.  
• You manage orders, parcels, deliveries and returns.  
• You organise gifts, flowers and thoughtful gestures.  
• You research and coordinate private travel, appointments and reservations.  
• You take care of practical arrangements involving vehicles, servicing and other everyday matters.   
And sometimes, something unexpected simply needs sorting out.
  
No problem. You focus on solutions, not obstacles!

An impressive CV? Great! But for this position, who you are and how you work matter just as much as what you've already accomplished.
  
We're looking for someone who's naturally organised. Not because they've learned to be, but because it's simply part of who they are. Someone who notices the little things, thinks ahead and genuinely enjoys bringing order to a busy day.
  
Does this sound like you?
    
• Organisation is second nature to you. You love structure, have an exceptional eye for detail and never lose sight of the bigger picture.  
• You're always thinking a few steps ahead. You spot what needs doing, take initiative and don't wait for instructions.  
• You take real ownership. When something is entrusted to you, others can count on it being handled from start to finish, without having to double-check.  
• Discretion comes naturally. You're trustworthy, reliable and understand the importance of confidentiality when professional and personal matters overlap.  
• You're hands-on, flexible and solution-oriented. You switch easily between different responsibilities and stay calm when unexpected situations arise.  
• You're a confident communicator and digitally savvy. You communicate clearly, feel comfortable with digital tools and adapt easily to different situations.  
• You genuinely enjoy making life easier for others. Knowing that someone can stop worrying about something because you've taken care of it? That's what motivates you!   
What else do you bring?
    
• A bachelor's degree and ideally some initial experience in an administrative, organisational or support role.  
• Previous experience in a similar position is a definite advantage, but the right attitude, maturity and potential to grow into the role are just as valuable.  
• Fluency in Dutch and English, both written and spoken, ideally together with good written French.  
• A valid category B driving licence.   
And the right personal fit? That's just as important to us.
  
You feel at home in a dynamic, informal environment with a relatively young team. You're positive, engaged and bring a healthy dose of common sense.
  
Ultimately, we're looking for someone management can turn to and say: "Could you take care of this?" And know it's in good hands.

jobs.occupation: Senior Key Account Manager / Business Development Manager Biometrics
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
   
• Identify, develop and win new strategic accounts within the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry, building relationships from initial prospecting through to contract award.  
• Own and develop a portfolio of key accounts, establishing account strategies, identifying growth opportunities and increasing share of wallet.  
• Build and maintain strong, multi-level relationships with key decision-makers, including Clinical Operations, Biometrics, Data Management, Statistics, Procurement and R&D stakeholders.  
• Develop a deep understanding of customer strategies, pipelines and outsourcing models to anticipate needs and position relevant SGS solutions proactively.  
• Drive new opportunities and expansion within existing accounts,  
• Lead strategic customer engagements, RFPs, negotiations and commercial discussions through to successful contract closure.  
• Develop and execute account plans and business development strategies, including target identification, opportunity qualification, pipeline development and revenue forecasting.  
• Actively build your network through industry events, conferences, professional networks and targeted business development activities.  
• Work closely with internal Clinical Research, Biometrics and commercial teams to develop tailored solutions and competitive value propositions.  
• Act as the voice of the customer internally, ensuring customer priorities are understood and reflected in proposals, delivery models and commercial strategies.  
• Establish strong internal stakeholder relationships and coordinate cross-functional teams around strategic opportunities and key accounts.  
• Maintain a high level of market intelligence, including competitor activity, outsourcing trends, pricing and customer priorities.  
• Ensure accurate and proactive management of opportunities, account plans and customer intelligence in the CRM system.  
• Contribute to the development of the Biometrics commercial strategy and identify new market segments, services and partnership opportunities. 

Your profile
   
• You hold a bachelor's or master's degree in Life Sciences, Business or an equivalent field.  
• You have 8+ years of relevant commercial experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, clinical research or CRO industry, ideally combining new business development and strategic account management.  
• You have a proven track record of winning new business and growing strategic accounts, preferably within CRO, Biometrics, Data Management, Biostatistics or related clinical development services.  
• You have a strong understanding of the clinical drug development process and the role of Biometrics throughout clinical development.  
• You are commercially driven and comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders across Clinical Operations, Biometrics, R&D, Procurement and executive management.  
• You have demonstrated experience managing complex sales cycles, strategic RFPs, negotiations and multi-stakeholder decision processes.  
• You are a strong hunter and relationship builder, able to open new accounts while developing long-term strategic partnerships.  
• You combine a strategic mindset with a hands-on approach to prospecting, opportunity development and account execution.  
• You are highly networked within the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry and comfortable representing the organization at conferences and industry events.  
• You have excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.  
• You are fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.
